description: Recommend the physical items needed for a real-life situation, activity, place, job or season — e.g. '겨울 캠핑 준비물', '아기 목욕', '이사 청소', '낚시', '김장', 'home gym', '용접 작업'. Returns matching situations from 만물도감's 500+ illustrated scenes (8,000+ labelled items), each with the item list, a picture link and shop search links (Coupang, Temu, Amazon). 만물도감 does not sell anything; it only links to sellers. Use this whenever a user asks what to buy or prepare for something.
name: recommend_for_situation
